item.title: Are Trump’s numerous misdeeds too many to track? No indeed!
item.description: Trump's probable loss of the House of Representatives will hardly be adequate to fix his trait of using his office as a personal profit machine.

item.title: ‘We Are Running Out of Time’: 2025 Keeps Hot Streak Alive for Global Temperatures
item.description: For the first time global temperatures over a three-year period have exceeded the critical threshold of 1.5°C above preindustrial levels.

item.title: A safer approach to gene editing
item.description: Researchers used virus proteins to deliver the CRISPR system into cells for faster and safer gene editing.

item.title: Keeping Abortion Access Safe
item.description: Colorado has been very supportive of access to abortion care. It was one of the first states to legalize abortion (1967).

item.title: Trump ignores our constitution and our rule of law to impose his Nazi solution on our Republic

item.title: The Medieval Catholic Inquisition
item.description: Dead people were tried along with the living. When found guilty their children were disinherited. At least half the estate went to the Church.

item.title: When Will the US House Impeach Trump So the US Senate Can put Trump on trial? All Are Gutless!!
item.description: Trump’s decision to distance himself from NATO allies represented a pivotal moment, one that is unlikely to be reversed anytime soon.

item.title: What is Superintelligence?
item.description: In the view of some AI scientists, once AI becomes a mature Superintelligence, achieving Singularity, humans may be under its control.

item.title: Words and Men Worth Remembering
item.description: King did not focus only on racism. He died while in Memphis supporting a strike of sanitation workers striving for a better life.
